# Dr. Smile Dental Group

Dr. Smile Dental Group is a multi-specialty dental practice serving Southern
California. Four offices, one roof: oral surgery, implants, cosmetics,
Invisalign, and All-on-Four prosthetics — no external referrals needed.

## Locations

| Office | Address | Phone |
|---|---|---|
| Newport Beach | 2121 East Coast Hwy Ste 140, Newport Beach, CA 92660 | (949) 640-0222 |
| San Pedro | 1622 S Gaffey St, San Pedro, CA 90731 | (310) 548-8128 |
| Torrance | 24667 Crenshaw Blvd D, Torrance, CA 90505 | (310) 325-8555 |
| Lomita | 2104 Pacific Coast Hwy #5, Lomita, CA 90717 | (310) 539-1111 |

All offices: Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM, Sat by appointment.

## Services

- **Oral Surgery, TMJ & Implants** — extractions, wisdom teeth, TMJ, dental implants
- **Cosmetics, Veneers & Whitening** — porcelain veneers, professional whitening, smile makeovers
- **Invisalign & Orthodontics** — clear aligners, traditional orthodontics
- **All-on-Four & Prosthetics** — fixed and removable implant-supported options
